root_idea.summary: The root centers on something going around, enclosing, or encompassing another thing.
root_idea.development: The basic notion of surrounding extends to guarding and gathering under protection, physical enclosures, comprehensive knowledge, and figurative overpowering that leaves no escape.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Feminine active-participle forms are presented under the masculine citation form مُحِيط.

senses.definition: To surround, encompass, encircle, enclose, or hem in.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in constructions of surrounding a person, place, or thing; Quranic active and passive forms express the same lexical relation with differing voice and aspect.

senses.definition: To beset or overwhelm completely, leaving no escape; figuratively, for a sin to gain mastery or for destruction or an affliction to overtake its object.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of surrounding in which the object is wholly overtaken. Quranic applications include sin, destructive affliction, spoiled fruit or possessions, and imminent or actual destruction.

senses.definition: To comprehend or know something completely, in all its circumstances and particulars.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with بِهِ, بِهِ عِلْمًا, or equivalent comprehensive-knowledge constructions; the emphasis is on nothing relevant escaping the knower.
Active-participle usage describing that which surrounds or encompasses another thing; the Quran applies the form to encompassing in a general or comprehensive sense.

senses.definition: Encompassing wholly in power, so that nothing escapes; hence besetting or destructive.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic figurative usage, especially of divine power or of a punishment that surrounds its object on every side and leaves no place of escape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To guard, protect, defend, care for, or attend to someone or something; also to manage its affairs and seek its good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes guarding kin, defending them, preserving ties of relationship, and providing active care or support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In an idiomatic expression, to keep or leave someone at a distance rather than approach or defend him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical or ironic use in expressions involving withdrawal and remoteness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A protective cord or ornament worn or hung to ward off the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an ornament of cord, beads, or a silver crescent used for women or boys.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a wild he-ass, to gather and guard its herd or mate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A zoological usage describing the he-ass drawing the group together and protecting it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To surround something with earth or build a wall or enclosure around it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of enclosing a vine or another object by an encircling structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take an affair within one's compass, power, or care; hence to control or monopolize it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical extension of physical enclosure to command or hold an affair within one's exclusive control.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take something entirely to oneself and debar others from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form IV usage of complete appropriation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To maneuver someone into turning or yielding, including by deceit or guile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of negotiating indirectly with someone who initially refuses a desired matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To use prudence or precaution, taking the surest course and seeking the most successful means.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with affairs or purposes for which a person chooses a safe and judicious method.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An object hung upon a boy to repel the evil eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported regional usage, associated with Yemen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosure or pen made for wheat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete enclosure term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that one soon quits, relinquishes, or abstains from.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported lexical usage of the same form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who guards, protects, or defends his family and brethren.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agentive personal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A monopolizer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later or contemporary tropical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An undertaker, superintendent, or manager of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun used in an affair-management construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wall, fence, or enclosing structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote a wall of wood, sticks, reeds, canes, or another material that surrounds what is within it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosed garden, especially a garden of palm trees surrounded by a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic extension from the enclosing wall to the enclosed garden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most prudent, comprehensive, or sure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the course that best gathers the applicable principles and is furthest from strained interpretations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A year of dearth, scarcity, or hardship that destroys animals or people; in another reported usage, a term of good omen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical usage with conflicting reported evaluations of the term's omen value.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place behind camels or other beasts and their people, surrounding and protecting them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place-name or descriptive noun for protected space behind a group of people or animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land enclosed by a wall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When not enclosed by a wall, the land is distinguished by another term for open or exposed country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slain or destroyed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic passive description of someone overtaken by destruction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A vine having a wall built around it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description of a walled or enclosed vine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prudent, cautious, or taking the sure course in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes a person who uses precaution and seeks the safest or most successful method.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Protection and care, idiomatic distance, and use of a protective ornament.
Surrounding with earth or a wall.
Taking an affair within one's compass or control.
Making a wall is covered by the broader enclosure meaning.
Maneuvering or inducing someone to yield.
Quran-attested overpowering or destruction and a separate appropriation usage.
Protective ornament against the evil eye.
Wheat enclosure and the separately reported sense of something soon relinquished.
Manager or superintendent of an affair.
Protective object hung on a boy.
Idiomatic sense of slain or destroyed.
Active-participle meaning of surrounding or enclosing.
Quran-attested encompassing power and destructive besetting.

cautions: Form IV أَحَاطَ spans spatial enclosure, figurative overpowering, and complete comprehension; these are separated by lexical construction and context rather than by voice or aspect.
The rare term تُحِيطُ is reported with both a destructive-dearth interpretation and, in one report, an auspicious interpretation.
